title: After the Vale ending (crown pocketed, doors left open, 'Act I' and 'The Barrow Doors' quests closed), the smith gets two new reactive dialogue lines about it, but the gray priest (who personally gave the blessing that opened the doors) and the elder (who owned the coffer the crown came from) both show zero new dialogue on revisit -- just 'leave him to his candles' / 'leave her to the ledgers'.
where: Gray Chapel / talk to gray priest; Elder's House / talk to elder
